body: # Earnings. AeroVironment soars 28% on earnings beat, backlog grows to $1.2 billion. Deutsche: One sector to drive double-digit growth in European earnings. This energy infrastructure stock is up 500% in past year. Why we like the stock. Micron says the AI party is far from over, but not all are celebrating. Micron stock jumps 15% as soaring prices from AI boom lead to quadrupling of revenue. ## Trending Now. Record chip rally adds $2 trillion in combined value to Micron, Intel and AMD in second quarter. Why FedEx is down after a strong quarter — and its impact on our stock rating. Databricks sales growth tops 80%, but margin are shrinking from swarm of AI agents. Oracle beats on earnings, but stock drops on plans to raise another $20 billion. Earnings put the rally to the test. CrowdStrike narrowly beats estimates on AI tailwinds, but stock falls 10%. We're upping our Palo Alto price target after strong earnings vanquish AI fears.
